card.name: Decreased or reduced before body function
card.fires_on: The words "decreased" or "reduced" placed before a body function, such as respiratory reserve, gastric motility or performance status. Also the start of "equilibrate" in instructions to warm to room temperature.

modes.label: Decreased/reduced function
modes.description: "Decreased" or "reduced" introduces a lowered physiological function in a warning list.
modes.example: evaluate patients for signs of urinary retention or<< reduced>> gastric motility when Hydrocodone Bit

modes.label: Equilibrate to room temperature
modes.description: The first piece of "equilibrate" in directions to let a product reach room temperature.
modes.example: allow the product to<< equ>>ilibrate to room temperature before patient use
